questions: When a price goes up or down, do you want to be able to change the price of an item that is already on the list?
Do you sell the same thing in different sizes or amounts at different prices, like one sachet versus a whole pack? If so, should each size have its own price?
When you look up a price, will you type the full name of the item, or should it also find items when you type only part of the name, like 'milk' finding 'Peak Milk'?
answers: Yes, prices change all the time, especially sugar, rice and oil. I need to change the price of an item.
